title: InsideEVs: The 2027 Cadillac Escalade IQ gets a NACS port and faster home charging
notes: 2027 IQ and IQL: native NACS, no adapter at Superchargers, 19.2 kW on all trims; 2026 Luxury and Sport 11.5 kW, Premium Luxury and Premium Sport 19.2 kW; 205 kWh. Charger upgrade found by GM Authority, not a direct GM statement. US only.
